text.tspan: Augmented Human Development Index: with vs. without income metric

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: The Augmented Human Development Index (AHDI) is a summary measure of historical achievement in four key dimensions
of human development: a long and healthy life, being knowledgeable, being free and having a decent standard of living. This
indicator is compared to a metric that excludes the standard of living dimension, measured by GDP per capita.
